data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

The first private lunar landing attempt, by Israel’s SpaceIL nonprofit. Crashed in April 2019 when an IMU gyroscope failure triggered repeated computer reboots, each shutting the engine down; by the time control was recovered, the lander was too low and fast to survive. Demonstrated that landing on the Moon is much harder than reaching it.
First privately-funded mission to reach the Moon; first Israeli lunar mission
First soft landing on lunar far side
Lander of India's Chandrayaan-2; it crashed in 2019, but the orbiter kept working
ExoMars precursor; lessons fed Rosalind Franklin
Japan's first private Moon landing attempts; Mission 1 (2023) and Mission 2 (2025) both crashed

First privately-funded lunar landing attempt — Israeli non-profit SpaceIL, 585 kg lander. Reached lunar orbit but a gyroscope failure during descent led to engine shutdown and a crash at ~950 m/s (nearly 1 km/s). Carrying a 'lunar library' of human knowledge etched on nickel discs, plus a sample of tardigrades — extremophiles capable of cryptobiosis — that may or may not have survived the impact. Inspired Beresheet 2 (planned).
